question.text: When <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mtext>p</mtext><mo>-</mo><mtext>n</mtext></math> junction diode is forward biased, then

options.text: the depletion region is reduced and barrier height is increased
the depletion region is widened and barrier height is reduced
both the depletion region and barrier height are reduced
both the depletion region and barrier height are increased

solution.text: When <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mtext>p</mtext><mo>-</mo><mtext>n</mtext></math> junction diode is forward biased, both the depletion region and barrier height are reduced.
